purpose: Readiness matrix for source-evidence review across black-hole benchmark and theory branches.

readiness_rows.name: EHT shadow benchmark package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The EHT benchmark is still a topic-local working copy rather than a normalized upstream archive.

readiness_rows.name: Image-domain and ray-tracing package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The current verifier checks only compact shadow-size agreement, not image-domain structure.

readiness_rows.name: Saturation-core mechanism package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The saturation-core path remains a heuristic diagnostic without a locked physical core scale.

readiness_rows.name: Gravitational-wave and ringdown package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: GW/ringdown scripts exist, but they are not yet primary-gated with a declared artifact contract.

readiness_rows.name: CCBH cosmological coupling package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: CCBH remains blocked until its upstream datasets are archived in the shared external cache.

claim_boundary: A ready row has enough provenance structure for source review. It does not by itself upgrade black-hole or GR claims.
